newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Trans Hex completes share issue.
newsitem.headline: Trans Hex completes share issue.

text.p: Diamond exploration company Trans Hex International Ltd announced on Thursday it had completed the issue and sale of 334,500 shares at C$2.75 a share for gross proceeds of C$919,875.
The issue represented the completion of its share offer following its prospectus released on December 9 last year.
According to a statement, Canaccord Capital Corp, which acted as agent, exercised its over-allotment option as a result of the offering of common shares being over-subscribed.
In total, Trans Hex raised C$21.402 million through the issue and sale of some 1.233 million common shares and 6.55 million special warrants.
Trans Hex has interests in exploration properties in the Central African Republic, Indonesia, Namibia, Brazil and Zimbabwe.
